entries.title: Skynd (crater)
entries.extract: Skynd is a crater on the surface of Uranus' moon Umbriel. It is estimated to be between 72 and 110 km in diameter. Its center is located at 1.8°S 331.7°E.

entries.title: Vuver (crater)
entries.extract: Vuver is a crater on the surface of Uranus' moon Umbriel. It is estimated to be 98 km in diameter. The longitude and latitude of its center are 311.6° and −4.7°, respectively.

entries.title: Wokolo (crater)
entries.extract: Wokolo is the largest crater on Umbriel, an Uranian Moon

entries.title: Wunda (crater)
entries.extract: Wunda is a large crater on the surface of Uranus' moon Umbriel. It is 131 km in diameter and is located near the equator of Umbriel. The crater is named after Wunda, a dark spirit of Australian aboriginal mythology.
